arxiv-1802-10217.creator: Rachit Dubey, Pulkit Agrawal, Deepak Pathak, Thomas L. Griffiths, Alexei A. Efros
arxiv-1802-10217.description: Abstract What makes humans so good at solving seemingly complex video games? Unlike computers, humans bring in a great deal of prior knowledge about the world, enabling efficient decision making. This paper investigates the role of human priors for solving video games.

arxiv-2011-10414.description: Abstract Maximum likelihood estimation of generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs) is difficult due to marginalization of the random effects. arxiv-2408-09898.title: Anatomy of the Star-formation in a Tidally Disturbed Disk galaxy: NGC 3718
arxiv-2408-09898.creator: Chandan Watts, Mousumi Das, Sudhanshu Barway
arxiv-2408-09898.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chandan Watts, Mousumi Das, Sudhanshu Barway. We present a UV, optical and near-infrared (near-IR) study of the star-forming complexes in the nearby peculiar galaxy NGC 3718, using UVIT, GALEX, Spitzer and DECaLS imaging data. The galaxy has a disturbed optical morphology due to the multiple tidal arms, the warped disk and the prominent curved dust lanes, but in the near-IR, it appears to be a bulge-dominated galaxy.
